summary: Spawner isn't in the creative inventory
description:
For a comprehensive list of other examples of issues with item positions in the Creative inventory, click here.

## The bug

The spawner is completely absent from the Creative inventory for some reason. It would be expected it would be there, as it isn't a very technical block like barriers or command blocks which have been intentionally kept out of the Creative inventory.

This is also a parity issue, as the spawner does appear in Bedrock Edition's creative inventory. The fact that it exists in the Creative inventory in Bedrock Edition may be due to some behavioural differences; placed spawners are empty by default in Bedrock Edition, but spawn pigs in Java Edition, so it may be advisable to make Java Edition's behaviour match Bedrock Edition's.

## How to reproduce

 - Give yourself a spawner: /give @p minecraft:spawner

 - Note the item name - this will be used for searching

 - Open the Creative inventory

 - Enter the Search tab

 - Search for Spawner

 - See no relevant results
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft and create a Creative world with default settings.
2. Enter `/give @p minecraft:spawner` in the chat.
3. Note the name of the item given to the player.
4. Open the Creative inventory.
5. Select the Search tab.
6. Enter `Spawner` in the search field.
7. Observe that no relevant spawner result appears in the Creative inventory.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 16w50a, 1.13-pre6, 1.16 Pre-release 2, 1.16 Pre-release 3, 1.16 Pre-release 5, 1.16 Release Candidate 1, 1.16, 1.16.1, 20w27a, 20w28a, 20w29a, 20w30a, 1.16.2 Pre-release 1, 1.16.2 Pre-release 2, 1.16.2 Pre-release 3, 1.16.2 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.2 Release Candidate 2, 1.16.2, 1.16.3 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.3, 20w46a, 20w48a, 21w03a, 1.16.5, 21w07a, 21w08b, 21w14a, 21w15a, 1.17, 1.17.1, 21w39a, 21w42a, 1.18 Pre-release 1, 1.18.1, 1.18.2, 22w11a, 1.19, 1.19.1 Pre-release 1, 1.19.1 Release Candidate 1, 1.19.1 Pre-release 5, 1.19.2, 22w42a (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior:
## Actual behavior

The `minecraft:spawner` block is not present anywhere in Java Edition’s Creative inventory, including the Search tab. Searching for “Spawner” produces no matching item, even though the item can be obtained with `/give @p minecraft:spawner`. Consequently, players in Creative mode must use a command or another external method to obtain a spawner.
Expected Behavior: The Spawner should be included as an obtainable block in the Java Edition Creative inventory. Searching for “Spawner” in the Creative inventory’s Search tab should display the spawner item, allowing the player to select and place it in the world, consistent with its availability in Bedrock Edition’s Creative inventory.
